title: Hundreds of delays, dozens of cancellations at Logan amid heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Nearly 500 flights delayed, 73 canceled at Logan Airport amid heavy rain.
JetBlue experienced 110 delays, while Republic Airways had 100 at Logan.
Boston forecast to receive 2-3 inches of rain by Thursday morning.

title: Which trade chips could Red Sox use to acquire another impact bat?
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Red Sox considering trading top prospect Franklin Arias, ranked No. 7 in MLB Pipeline’s Top 100, for a major bat.
Marcelo Mayer may be included in trade deals due to disappointing 2026 performance and concerns over his durability.
Boston pitchers Payton Tolle, Jake Bennett, and Anthony Eyanson are potential trade assets for acquiring offensive talent.

title: Wellfleet police release plea for help from public in 2025 homicide
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Timothy Duval Jr., 24, was killed by a vehicle in Wellfleet, Massachusetts, in May 2025.
Wellfleet Police and Cape and Islands District Attorney seek public assistance in 2025 homicide investigation.
Authorities encourage information sharing via Detective Jack Poska at 508-349-2100 to solve the case.

title: New report sheds light on Curtis Mead’s potential return to Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Curtis Mead of the Boston Red Sox will not require surgery for his broken wrist sustained during his debut game.
Mead received a tentative 6-8 week recovery timeline, potentially allowing him to return before the regular season ends on September 27.
Acquired from the Nationals, Mead's absence is a setback for Boston, which ranks 29th in home runs this season.

title: Hennessy’s in downtown Boston has closed, plans to transfer liquor license to new Seaport restaurant
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: Hennessy's Bar in downtown Boston closed after nearly 30 years, planning to transfer its liquor license to Bar 23 in Seaport.
Bar 23, a Grill 23-spin-off, will open next year in Seaport, featuring a 75-seat steak-focused restaurant at 11 Fan Pier Blvd.
Hennessy's, part of Somers Boston Restaurants Inc., was voted 'Best Irish Bar in Boston' and known for its traditional Irish ambiance.

title: Framingham remote Logan terminal will be extended through March
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Since June 1, 10,000 passengers have used the Logan remote terminal in Framingham, MassPort reported.
Delta and JetBlue passengers can access TSA screening at the terminal for $9 each way, from 5:30 a.m. to 4 p.m.
MassPort plans to extend the remote terminal's pilot through March and consider opening additional remote terminals.

title: Sonny Gray reportedly interested in signing extension with Red Sox
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Sonny Gray expressed interest in a contract extension with the Boston Red Sox despite free agency potential.
Gray has an impressive 2026 record with Boston, posting a 12-2 win-loss record and a 2.78 ERA.
The Red Sox improved their standing with an 18-4 July, influencing Gray's interest in remaining in Boston.

title: Teen driver killed, 4 others hospitalized in stolen SUV crash in Abington
author: Samantha Genzer
bullets: A 17-year-old driver was killed in a crash involving a stolen Hyundai Santa Fe in Abington.
Abington Police were tracking the vehicle before it crashed into a tree on Washington St.
Four passengers aged 14 to 17 were hospitalized with serious or life-threatening injuries after the crash.

title: Celtics ‘expressed interest’ in LeBron James in free agency before he joined 76ers
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: The Boston Celtics showed interest in signing LeBron James during free agency before he joined the Philadelphia 76ers.
LeBron James, at 41, signed a two-year deal with the 76ers, joining a roster with Jaylen Brown and Joel Embiid.
Despite averaging 20.9 points last season, James reportedly never considered Boston a top destination due to past rivalries.

title: Parts of Mass. under flash flood warning as state sees heavy rain
author: Madison Lucchesi
bullets: Flash flood warning in effect for Western Massachusetts, including Springfield, Chicopee, and Westfield, until 6 p.m. Wednesday.
Berkshire County faces a separate flood warning until 5:45 p.m. with up to 7 inches of rain expected.
Flood watch extended across Central and Western Massachusetts, Eastern Rhode Island, and Connecticut until 8 p.m.
